intro.title: Build typed OpenAPI client generator skeleton
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build the skeleton for a typed OpenAPI client generator using TypeScript. You'll learn how to create a basic structure that can later be expanded to automatically generate type-safe API clients from OpenAPI specifications. The core concept involves using TypeScript's type system and interfaces to define the shape of API requests and responses. You'll work with key constructs like interfaces, type aliases, and basic file organization. By the end, you'll have a foundational project setup ready for integrating OpenAPI parsing logic.
intro.usecase: This pattern is essential for building API clients in modern web applications like e-commerce platforms, where product listings need typed API calls to fetch and filter items. In dashboard tools such as analytics or admin panels, typed clients ensure safe data retrieval from multiple endpoints for charts and tables. Developers use this skeleton to generate reliable TypeScript clients from OpenAPI specs, reducing runtime errors in forms, search filters, and data submission flows. It's a foundational step for maintaining type safety across frontend-backend communication in scalable applications.
